value.name: waits for social worker reply
value.description: Asha leaves her phone face down while waiting for the social worker to respond.
evidence: The phone stayed face down on the counter for the length of time it took the kettle she had not turned on to fail to whistle, and then it lit up against the laminate with the social worker's reply.

value.name: receives step-down bed confirmation
value.description: Asha reads that the county step-down bed has been confirmed for two o'clock and that intake will contact her for consent and transport.
evidence: Asha turned it over and read that the county step-down bed had been confirmed for two o'clock, that intake would call her once for consent and once more before transport, and that Marcus had been told.

value.name: pauses in apartment
value.description: Asha sets the phone down and briefly lets herself remain in the apartment without giving anything else away.
evidence: She set the phone down again and stood with her hands flat on the counter and let the apartment be the apartment for another half minute, the one room she had not given away,

value.name: answers unknown billing call
value.description: Asha receives a call from Bridgepoint's billing line asking whether her deposit should be held or refunded because the admissions packet is incomplete.
evidence: and then her phone lit a second time with a number she did not know and a Trenton area code, and Bridgepoint's billing line was on the other end asking whether the deposit she had wired on Friday should be held against the bed they were still holding for her father or released back to her account, because the admissions packet had come back without the co-signer's notarized signature and the facility could not place him on Wednesday without it.

value.name: asks to hold deposit
value.description: Asha tells the billing agent to keep the deposit applied to the bed instead of returning it.
evidence: Asha turned the phone over and told the billing agent to hold the deposit where it sat.

value.name: requests forty-eight-hour extension
value.description: Asha asks for forty-eight hours to secure the missing signature and says she will have an answer by Wednesday afternoon.
evidence: She heard the woman's keyboard pause on the other end, and into that pause she asked for forty-eight hours against the bed, said it plainly, said her brother's signature was the gap and that she would have an answer before three on Wednesday.

value.name: billing agent records request
value.description: The billing agent repeats Asha's request in a practiced, resigned tone, implying this kind of delay is familiar.
evidence: The agent read back the request in the flat voice of someone who had said yes to this before and watched the yes expire,
